chapter: Brass bands, Buddy Petit and horns
title: Buddy Petit and the borrowed horn
summary: The interviewer asks about Buddy Petit; Nicholas remembers Buddy and a story about lending him a horn.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Buddy Bolden and Buddy Petit: the trumpet legends

blocks.x: Well, tell us something about Buddy Petit. He said, you know what Buddy said?
I said, yeah, I don't know. I'll tell you. And, uh, you might get him regular. But he ain't playing the record now. And there's two same guy brothers crooked. Buddy Petit. Yeah, two same guys.
I heard a lot of stories about him.

He's so glad he couldn't get him. I bought him a little fool with him, you know. Frankly the same way. I'm too crooked fellas. They're all down to themselves. So he got to Frank. They worked together. They worked pretty good while together. I think you told me once something about Buddy Petit learning on your horn.
Did you sell him a horn or what was that?
